                                   Resolution 2023-02
                      Of the Girdwood Board of Supervisors
                        RESOLUTION OF SUPPORT
                                          For
             MUNICIPALTY OF ANCHORAGE TO APPLY FOR FUNDS ON
                    BEHALF OF GIRDWOOD FIRE DEPT

WHEREAS, Girdwood Fire and Rescue Inc (GFR) has identified need of a Wildfire Brush Truck to replace
Brush Truck 41 to ensure wildfire preparedness in the Girdwood Valley; and

WHEREAS, GFR has identified funding needs to adequately prepare our Community Emergency Response
Team (CERT); and

WHEREAS, the Municipality of Anchorage is able to receive funding for these types of equipment through
state and federal homeland security and forestry agencies to meet the needs of Areawide service; and

WHEREAS, using state and federal funding opportunities available to the MOA for this equipment and
apparatus would leave more Girdwood taxpayer funds available for fire response in the Girdwood Fire Service
Area.

THEREFORE, the Girdwood Board of Supervisors encourages the Municipality of Anchorage to seek funding
from state and federal homeland security and forestry agencies on behalf of Girdwood for replacement of Brush
41, our wildfire brush truck and for supplies for the Girdwood Community Emergency Response Team.


PASSED AND APPROVED by a vote of 4 to 0 this 16th day of January, 2023.





Guy Wade
GBOS Fire Dept Chair                               Attest
